snippet.title: Sydless | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🥎 SYDLESS IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM! 🍔

Get it now with a limited-time launch discount for just US$9.89: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524780/Sydless/ 

Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

Welcome to Randy's Burgers: a 90s fast-food warped into a hostile fever dream. Play as Diego, an overworked employee whose customers have turned into monsters, and find out why your boss is trapped behind that door. Chain moves together to build unstoppable momentum, because standing still means death. Your weapon? A chaotic, unpredictable bouncing ball. Rack up combos to make it deadlier and track its ricochets to maximize every hit. Each level scores your speed, skill, and efficiency, so push yourself to climb the leaderboard. Equip rings with unique powers to help you survive and master every stage of this relentless neon nightmare.

Our Socials: https://linktr.ee/opiagames
